jobs.title: Cyber Security Instructor
jobs.description:
Company: Aishwi Technologies LLP

Location: Bhubaneswar, Odisha, India (Onsite)

Job Type: Short-Term Contract (3 Months, with a strong possibility of extension to 1 Year)

Compensation: ₹50,000 / month

Perks: Travel, Food, and Accommodation provided by the company

About the Role

Are you passionate about shaping the next generation of cyber defenders? Aishwi Technologies LLP is looking for a dynamic, hands-on Cybersecurity Instructor to join our team onsite in Bhubaneswar.

In this role, you will lead training sessions, mentor learners through real-world attack-and-defense scenarios, and equip them with industry-relevant cybersecurity skills. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced security professional to make a direct impact in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities
• Deliver Training: Conduct comprehensive, high-quality, and interactive sessions on core cybersecurity concepts, tools, and best practices.
• Hands-on Mentorship: Guide students through practical labs, penetration testing simulations, vulnerability assessments, and defensive security frameworks.
• Curriculum Alignment: Ensure training delivery matches current industry standards, emerging threat landscapes, and modern security toolsets.
• Progress Tracking: Evaluate participant performance, provide constructive feedback, and support them in troubleshooting technical challenges.

What We Are Looking For
• Experience: Minimum 1 year of professional experience in cybersecurity, ethical hacking, security engineering,or technical instruction.
• Technical Proficiency: Strong working knowledge of networking fundamentals, operating systems (Linux/Windows), vulnerability assessment, and common security tools (e.g., Wireshark, Nmap, Burp Suite,Metasploit).
• Communication Skills: Excellent interpersonal and public-speaking skills with the ability to break down complex technical topics for learners.
• Certifications (Preferred): Relevant certifications such as CEH, CompTIA Security+, OSCP, or equivalent are a plus.

Compensation & Benefits
• Salary: ₹50,000 per month
• Duration: 3 Months (with strong potential for extension up to 1 Year)
• Relocation Support: Free travel, food, and accommodation provided for the duration of the onsite assignment in Bhubaneswar.

jobs.description:
Cybersecurity Instructor – Trainee

Company: Cyber Lancers Pvt. Ltd.

Location: Belagavi, Karnataka (On-site)

Employment Type: Full-time Trainee

Duration: 6 Months (Opportunity for continuation based on performance)

Experience: Freshers / 0–1 Years

Job Description

Cyber Lancers Pvt. Ltd. is looking for enthusiastic and motivated individuals to join our team as Cybersecurity Instructor Trainees.

The selected candidates will be responsible for conducting hands-on cybersecurity training sessions, guiding students through practical exercises, and supporting the maintenance and operation of cybersecurity lab environments.

Key Responsibilities
• Conduct hands-on cybersecurity training sessions for students.
• Guide students through cybersecurity fundamentals, ethical hacking, and web application security exercises.
• Assist students with practical lab activities and technical troubleshooting.
• Support the setup, maintenance, and monitoring of cybersecurity lab environments.
• Track student progress, conduct assessments, and maintain training records.
• Coordinate with faculty and technical teams for effective training delivery.

Required Skills
• Basic understanding of cybersecurity concepts and ethical hacking fundamentals.
• Knowledge of computer networking, including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, and IP addressing.
• Familiarity with Linux operating systems and basic command-line operations.
• Basic understanding of web application security and common vulnerabilities.
• Good communication, presentation, and problem-solving skills.
• Willingness to learn and explore new cybersecurity tools and technologies.

Educational Qualifications
• BCA / MCA / B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Science, Cybersecurity, or related disciplines.
• Fresh graduates with an interest in cybersecurity and technical training are encouraged to apply.

Preferred Skills
• Familiarity with Kali Linux and basic cybersecurity tools.
• Exposure to vulnerability assessment and penetration testing.
• Basic understanding of virtual machines and networking environments.
• Interest in teaching, mentoring, and technical demonstrations.

What We Offer
• Hands-on exposure to cybersecurity tools and technologies.
• Opportunity to develop technical and instructional skills.
• Practical experience in cybersecurity training and lab operations.
• Professional learning and career development opportunities.
• Opportunity for continuation based on performance.

jobs.title: Assistant Manager - Information Security
jobs.description:
About The Company

Tata Communications Redefines Connectivity with Innovation and IntelligenceDriving the next level of intelligence powered by Cloud, Mobility, Internet of Things, Collaboration, Security, Media services and Network services, we at Tata Communications are envisaging a New World of Communications

Job Description – Assistant Manager, Information Security

Department: Audit & Certification

Position Type: Full-time, replacement position

Minimum Qualification: Engineering Degree

Preferred Certification: ISO 27001 Lead Auditor , CEH, OSCP/OSCP+, GPEN, CREST Registered Penetration Tester (CRT)

Role Summary

Support the organization’s information security programmed through vulnerability assessment and penetration testing coordination, compliance management, governance, risk management. The role includes supporting DevSecOps activities, tracking remediation, and publishing security dashboards and management reports.

Key Responsibilities

• Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VA/PT)
• Coordinate VA/PT activities for applications, infrastructure, and networks.
• Review assessment findings and work with technical teams to priorities remediation.
• Track vulnerabilities, remediation timelines, and closure evidence.
• Coordinate retesting and escalate overdue or critical findings.
• Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC)
• Support information security risk assessments and maintain risk registers.
• Monitor compliance with security policies, standards, and applicable requirements.
• Track control gaps, corrective actions, and risk treatment plans.
• Coordinate with stakeholders to collect and validate compliance evidence.
• DevSecOps
• Support the integration of security activities into the software development lifecycle.
• Coordinate with development and DevOps teams on SAST, DAST, and Software Composition Analysis findings.
• Track application security issues and support remediation verification.
• Promote secure development and deployment practices.
• Dashboards and Management Reporting
• Prepare and publish security dashboards, VA/ PT Status reports, and compliance status updates.
• Report vulnerability trends, audit findings, risk status, and remediation progress.
• Maintain accurate KPI and KRI data for management review.
• Use Microsoft Excel to analyses data and produce clear reports.

Required Skills And Competencies

• Practical knowledge of vulnerability assessment and penetration testing.
• Knowledge of DevSecOps and application security testing.
• Knowledge of governance, risk management, and compliance processes.
• Working knowledge of ISO 27001 requirements and information security controls.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including PivotTables, lookup functions, formulas, charts, and data analysis.
• Ability to prepare dashboards, management reports, and audit documentation.
• Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder coordination skills.
• Ability to manage multiple activities and follow through on remediation commitments.

Educational Qualification and Certification

• Mandatory: Engineering Degree from a recognized institution.
• Added advantages: ISO 27001 certification, such as Internal Auditor, Lead Auditor, or Lead Implementer.
• CEH, OSCP/OSCP+, GPEN, CREST Registered Penetration Tester (CRT)

Key Performance Expectations

• Timely coordination and completion of planned security assessments and compliance activities.
• Consistent tracking, follow-up, and escalation of vulnerabilities, risks, and audit observations.
• Verification of remediation evidence and timely coordination of retesting.
• Accurate and timely publication of security dashboards and management reports.
• Effective collaboration with technical and business stakeholders to address identified security and compliance gaps.

jobs.title: Offensive Security And AI Security Senior Expert
jobs.description:
Job Description

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly experienced, hands-on Senior Cybersecurity Architect/Engineer specialising in Offensive Security, Red Team operations, AI Security, and Enterprise Security Architecture.

The successful candidate will combine strong offensive security expertise with the ability to design, implement, and validate enterprise-wide security controls across cloud-native environments, applications, infrastructure, and AI-enabled platforms.

Responsibilities2. DevSecOps & Secure Engineering3. Cloud & Enterprise Security Architecture4. Security Operations, Threat Detection & Incident Response5. AI Security Architecture & Implementation6. Data Security, Privacy & Governance7. Security Risk, Compliance & GovernanceRequirements

• Offensive Security, Red Team & Purple Team Operations
• Lead Red Team engagements, including planning, scoping, execution, resource allocation, quality assurance, and reporting.
• Manage internal Red Team resources and external penetration testing and vulnerability assessment (VAPT) providers.
• Execute adversarial simulations covering initial access, privilege escalation, lateral movement, identity compromise, and Active Directory attack paths.
• Conduct penetration testing across web applications, infrastructure, networks, and enterprise environments.
• Lead Purple Team exercises to validate detection and response capabilities and identify gaps in existing security controls.
• Translate offensive security findings into actionable remediation plans and improvements to detection engineering.
• Develop or adapt attack scripts, automation, and custom tooling to simulate advanced adversarial scenarios.
• Integrate security testing into CI/CD pipelines, including Static Application Security Testing (SAST), Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST), Software Composition Analysis (SCA), and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) scanning.
• Implement automated security gates, policy-as-code, and security validation workflows.
• Establish secure development practices across containerised environments, including Docker, Kubernetes, and artifact registries.
• Collaborate with software engineering and platform teams to embed security controls throughout the software development lifecycle.
• Automate security checks, compliance validation, and remediation processes wherever possible.
• Design and implement security architecture and guardrails across cloud, on-premises, and hybrid environments.
• Define controls for identity and access management, privileged access, network segmentation, encryption, secrets management, and workload protection.
• Establish secure configuration baselines and integrate security requirements into cloud adoption and infrastructure deployment.
• Assess cloud environments against recognised security frameworks and benchmarks, prioritising risks and coordinating remediation.
• Design and validate disaster recovery, high availability, and resilience strategies across infrastructure, identity, networks, and applications.
• Conduct recovery and failover testing to validate security controls and identify weaknesses in backup, recovery, and resilience mechanisms.
• Improve security monitoring and threat detection capabilities across cloud and on-premises environments.
• Develop and optimise SIEM detection rules, log ingestion, alert triage, and threat-hunting processes.
• Lead incident response activities, including investigation, containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident reviews.
• Integrate threat intelligence and adversary techniques into detection engineering and proactive threat hunting.
• Work closely with Red and Blue Teams to improve detection coverage, response effectiveness, and overall security maturity.
• Design and implement security controls across the AI/ML lifecycle, including data protection, model access, application security, and AI supply-chain risk.
• Assess the security of LLM-powered applications, AI agents, and AI platforms.
• Identify and mitigate AI-specific threats, including prompt injection, insecure output handling, data leakage, excessive agency, and model-related vulnerabilities.
• Implement AI security guardrails, monitoring, adversarial testing, and secure integration patterns for AI-enabled applications.
• Translate emerging AI security risks, standards, and regulatory requirements into practical architecture, policies, and engineering controls.
• Support the secure adoption of AI technologies across enterprise environments.
• Design and implement data security controls covering data classification, discovery, inventory, retention, and secure handling.
• Implement encryption, key management, tokenisation, data loss prevention (DLP), and data access governance.
• Strengthen security across databases, storage platforms, and structured and unstructured data environments.
• Collaborate with privacy, legal, and business stakeholders to ensure data processing complies with relevant regulatory and contractual obligations.
• Support privacy impact assessments and the implementation of appropriate technical safeguards.
• Conduct security risk assessments, control reviews, and compliance gap assessments.
• Support compliance with applicable frameworks and regulations, including ISO 27001, NIST, CIS Controls, PCI DSS, GDPR, and relevant UAE regulatory requirements.
• Translate business and regulatory obligations into practical technical security controls.
• Track remediation of audit findings, vulnerabilities, risk exceptions, and control gaps.
• Provide clear reporting on security risks, remediation progress, and control effectiveness to technical and business stakeholders.
• Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Security, Cybersecurity, or a related discipline.
• 8+ years of hands-on cybersecurity engineering or architecture experience.
• At least 5 years of experience leading or managing offensive security engagements, Red Team operations, or equivalent security assessment activities.
• Demonstrable experience coordinating Red Team, Blue Team, and Purple Team activities.
• Strong technical understanding of common attack techniques, including SQL injection, cross-site scripting (XSS), server-side request forgery (SSRF), remote code execution (RCE), and insecure direct object references (IDOR).
• Experience assessing Windows and Linux environments, enterprise networks, identity systems, privilege escalation, lateral movement, and attack paths.
• Practical familiarity with offensive security tools such as Burp Suite, Metasploit, Nmap, and Nessus.
• Experience with DevSecOps practices, CI/CD security integration, container security, and infrastructure-as-code scanning.
• Strong understanding of cloud security architecture, preferably within Microsoft Azure, with AWS or multi-cloud experience also beneficial.
• Experience designing or implementing AI security controls for LLM applications, AI agents, or AI platforms.
• Knowledge of data protection, encryption, secrets management, identity security, and privacy controls.
• Ability to lead complex security projects from architecture and implementation through testing, delivery, and operational handover.
• Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical security risks and solutions to engineering teams and senior stakeholders.

jobs.title: Regional Sales Manager – Middle East (Cybersecurity)
jobs.description:
Meet Yubico

Yubico is a global leader in identity security and creator of the YubiKey, the original hardware-backed passkey. We are publicly traded on Nasdaq Stockholm; our global footprint includes headquarters in Stockholm, Sweden, Silicon Valley, California; and Singapore.

Why Join Our Mission?

At Yubico, We Are Guided By a Shared Belief That Your Work Matters. We Operate Under a Cultural Philosophy Of Speed With Integrity, Pushing The Boundaries Of Technology To Secure The AI Frontier—protecting Both Human And Agentic AI Interactions—and Leading The Transition To Post-quantum Cryptography. In Everything We Do, We Live By Our Core Values

• Battle Friction: We constantly look for new ways to simplify our products, our work, and the user experience.
• Inspire Higher: We think big, champion the open internet, and strive to do the right thing even when it is difficult.
• One Team: We are open, responsive, and collaborative, overcoming challenges and celebrating our successes together.

Aligned with our commitment to open standards, we foster a thriving builder ecosystem through the Yubico Developer Program, offering free open-source repositories, libraries, and SDKs to help developers rapidly integrate strong hardware authentication into any application. Through close collaborations with technical partners like Google, Microsoft, and Amazon, as well as newer frontiers like OpenAI, we continue to shape a safer digital world while donating security keys to protect vulnerable communities, journalists, and humanitarian groups worldwide through our Secure it Forward program.

The Role

Yubico is looking for an energetic, results-driven Sales Manager to accelerate enterprise growth across the United Arab Emirates (UAE) and the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA). This is a specialized Enterprise Cybersecurity & Identity sales role requiring direct experience selling to GCC enterprise, government, and banking accounts. Based on the ground in Dubai, you will serve as the primary door-opener and strategic deal owner in the region, operating with a strong "hunter" mindset to secure strategic enterprise accounts.

Working in close alignment with our Dubai-based Channel Manager and Solutions Engineer, you will directly drive top-tier enterprise opportunities across Government, Banking & Financial Services, Defense, Energy, and Telecommunications.

Task & Responsibilities

• Direct Revenue & Territory Growth: Drive end-to-end sales execution for major target accounts across the UAE and Saudi Arabia to expand Yubico’s regional footprint.
• Enterprise Door-Opening & Prospecting: Actively build, qualify, and advance a robust sales pipeline, holding direct executive meetings with CISOs, CIOs, CTOs, and IT leadership.
• Strategic Ecosystem Collaboration: Work in tandem with the regional Channel Manager to co-sell through top-tier regional distributors, elite resellers, and MSSPs.
• High-Impact Deal Focus: Lead complex negotiations and commercial strategy for high-value strategic deployments ($500K+ deal focus), delegating mid-market run-rate business to partners.
• Local Market Agility: Leverage your physical presence in Dubai to engage clients directly, adapt seamlessly to local business dynamics and spontaneous scheduling, and establish strong strategic relationships.
• Cross-Functional Synergy: Partner closely with internal Solutions Engineering, Channel Leadership, and Legal to structure seamless proof-of-concept (POC) projects and enterprise agreements.

Basic Qualifications

• Bilingual Proficiency (Preferred): Professional fluency in English is required; native or professional Arabic fluency is highly preferred. Exceptional candidates with a proven track record and strong enterprise relationships across the GCC will be strongly considered regardless of Arabic proficiency.
• Experience & Track Record: 5+ years of proven enterprise sales success in Cybersecurity, Identity & Access Management (IAM), Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), or Hardware Security/Authentication Solutions across the Middle East.
• Hunter Mentality: Demonstrated history of developing new territories, opening doors at tier-1 enterprise organizations, and consistently exceeding revenue targets.
• GCC Enterprise Domain Expertise: Deep understanding of the buying processes, decision-making structures, and compliance landscapes in key regional verticals (Government, Banking/Finance, Defense, Energy, Telecom).
• Channel & Ecosystem Acumen: Strong experience navigating dual co-selling models (direct enterprise engagement complemented by two-tier channel distribution execution).
• Local Availability: Currently based in or willing to relocate immediately to Dubai, UAE, with ability to travel up to 30–50% within the UAE and Saudi Arabia.

We are an equal opportunity employer, we value diversity and uphold an inclusive environment where all people feel that they are equally respected and valued. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, marital status, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law. We'd love to learn about what you can add to our diverse team. We are an E-Verify Participating Employer.

Yubico does not accept agency resumes or referrals so please do not send them to our careers staff or employees. Yubico is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes or referrals.

Personal data submitted through this form is used for managing Yubico’s recruitment activities, which include facilitating any application you make, setting up and conducting interviews and tests for applicants, evaluating and assessing results and selecting candidates, and as otherwise needed in our recruitment and onboarding processes. The use of your personal data may also be necessary prior to entering into a contract with you (that is prior to offering you a job with Yubico). Your personal data will only be used for the purposes for which it was collected and in accordance with the Yubico Privacy Notice. We only keep your personal data for as long as necessary and in compliance with Yubico’s record retention policies. If you have asked us to, we will keep you informed of other opportunities at Yubico. We do this in various ways, including email and by phone. If at any time you do not want us to contact you or use your information as described herein please contact us at jobs@yubico.com to let us know and we will delete all such information. Providing your personal data is voluntary, but necessary to join our talent community, and if you do not agree to provide your data, we will not be able to consider you as part of our talent community.

As part of providing the requested service, we will transfer your data to be processed by Greenhouse Software Inc., a service provider contracted by Yubico AB and/or its subsidiaries that meets legally mandated privacy requirements. jobs.title: Information Security Specialist
jobs.description:
We are looking to hire an Information Security Specialist who will be responsible for managing and supporting information security governance, risk assessments, security controls, and compliance initiatives for our government client based in Dubai.

The role will be on 12-month renewable contract.

The role sits within the Information Technology Department.

We are looking for a passionate Information Security Specialist who is committed to protecting IT infrastructure, applications, systems, and information assets against security threats and vulnerabilities. You should also have experience in information security governance, risk assessment, security architecture, and compliance with information security frameworks, including Dubai Government's Information Security Regulation (ISR) and Information Security Management Systems (ISMS).

Key responsibilities:
• Manage and support the organisation's information security environment, ensuring IT infrastructure, networks, applications, and systems are protected against threats and vulnerabilities in line with recognised security standards.
• Support the implementation and ongoing compliance of Dubai Government's Information Security Regulation (ISR) and Information Security Management System (ISMS) frameworks.
• Investigate information security incidents, system misuse, unauthorised access attempts, and violations of information security policies.
• Conduct information security threat and risk assessments across IT infrastructure, applications, systems, and communications, recommending appropriate mitigation measures.
• Monitor and evaluate information security hardware and software performance, assessing the impact of vendor changes, system upgrades, and emerging technologies on the existing security environment.
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of information security policies, controls, processes, and technologies.
• Research, assess, and support the implementation of new information security technologies to strengthen the organisation's security posture.
• Coordinate with external suppliers and service providers on technical support, security solutions, contracts, and related requirements.
• Collaborate with internal IT and business teams to maintain the availability, reliability, and scalability of IT services in line with business requirements and service-level agreements (SLAs).
• Ensure adherence to organisational quality standards, information security policies, and applicable ISR and ISMS requirements.

Knowledge, skills & experience:
• Proven experience in information security, cybersecurity, IT risk management, or information security governance.
• Practical experience with information security frameworks, preferably Dubai Government's ISR and ISMS requirements.
• Strong knowledge of information security risk assessments, threat identification, vulnerability management, and security control implementation.
• Experience assessing the security of IT infrastructure, networks, applications, systems, and communications.
• Understanding of information security policies, compliance requirements, audit processes, and remediation activities.
• Knowledge of security architecture, security monitoring, incident investigation, and information security technologies.
• Experience coordinating with internal IT teams, external vendors, and service providers to address security requirements and technical issues.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
• Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer, or ISO 27001 Lead Auditor would be an advantage.

Availability:
• Preference will be given to candidates available immediately.

We are looking for a candidate who will be able to work in the United Arab Emirates. Please apply with your resume and remember to provide us with your contact details.

We will review your job application within 7 working days. Should your profile fit the requirements of the role, a consultant from Edari will be in touch with you to gain a deeper understanding of your profile, discuss the role in more detail, and outline potential next steps.
